meta.title: About SGS International | EPC & O&M Contractor
meta.description: SGS is an EPC and O&M contractor delivering solar, water, and civil infrastructure projects for clients across the GCC, MENA, and international markets.

hero.title: An EPC & O&M contractor for essential infrastructure
hero.text: We deliver solar, water, and civil infrastructure projects — from design and construction through to commissioning and O&M.

team.title: The people behind the work
team.intro: A focused team of engineers, project managers, and operators who deliver projects from design through to handover.

members.name: Mustafa Shriem, PMP
members.description: Leads project delivery and operations across the company's solar, water, and civil work.

members.name: Ali Shriem
members.description: Leads construction and site execution, from procurement through to build and commissioning.

intro.title: Built on delivery
intro.text: We are an EPC and O&M contractor working across solar PV, water treatment, and civil infrastructure. Our track record is anchored by 5 delivered water treatment plants, and we apply the same approach to projects across the GCC, MENA, and international markets.

pillars.title: Deliver reliable infrastructure under a single point of accountability
Be a trusted EPC and O&M partner across sectors and international markets
Practical engineering, disciplined delivery, and clear communication

market_focus.title: Regional reach, international outlook
market_focus.text: We work with public and private sector clients across the GCC, MENA, Europe, and Africa — bringing a proven delivery record and a practical, hands-on approach to every market.

why_section.kicker: We were created out of the necesseity to facilitate more water treatment in a growing water scarce region of the Middle East.
why_section.title: Our roots.
